exposure: poor quality of care during labor
cohort: Singleton stillbirths with birthweight ≥2000 g (n = 139) compared to controls with birthweight ≥2000 g and Apgar score ≥7 (n = 249)
finding: This study in an East African referral hospital found that poor quality of care during labour was the predominant determinant of intrapartum stillbirths, highlighting the need for improved obstetric care to prevent these tragedies.
mod_finding: The caesarean section rate among all stillbirths was 26% compared to 11% among controls (OR 2.94, 95% CI 1.68-5.14).
